I respect this game as a starting point in the franchise, but I like Risk Of Rain 2 a lot more due to it's modern and smooth gameplay.

Controls and gameplay here are frustrating, art style is decent, only lore and music are great.
You'll have a hard time playing if you're not into 2d platformers - your movements need to be very precise in order to get through the stages.

I wouldn't recommend to play this old release unless you want to experience the nostalgia of early, janky indie games.
Don't play this garbage, buy the second part
It is very hard at first but over time once you get more experienced it becomes very enjoyable.

Cool game, surprisingly hard compared to RoR2
